authorization: Standing auto-approval of independently inspected matching whole-function/unit disposal services, applied to the actual negative-reference Swiss class-2 wastewater treatment and its positive-reference native counterpart. The closer native target removes an erroneous extra residential-collection stage while preserving the complete treatment plant and its internal sewer infrastructure. No new waste grade, treatment fate, helper, recovery model, physical quantity basis or reconstruction is introduced.

authorization_evidence.authorization: Standing independently inspected matching-material/function/unit disposal and geographic-proxy approvals, applied only after matching the declared wet composition, biogenic-carbon fraction, treatment class, actual cement/residue/facility coordinates and opposite one-kg waste/service reference signs for the enumerated pilot cases. No new waste grade, stabilization process, recovery model, helper or unit conversion is introduced.

Standing independently inspected matching whole-material/function/unit and geographic supply-service proxy approvals,including same-mode whole-freight precedents,applied only to the enumerated actual pilot profiles after checking positive references,producer definitions and complete native material/service boundaries. No new grade,unit conversion,helper,recovery model,individual traction substitution or empty inventory is introduced.

limitations: Same complete Swiss class-2 municipal wastewater treatment per m3, with 71100 population-capacity equivalents, declared COD 0.1556 kg/m3, three-stage mechanical/biological/chemical treatment and sludge digestion. Select the existing native treatment process without the additional Residential sewer grid in the previous from-residence target. Source and target retain their class-2 plant and internal sewer-grid infrastructure; do not remove that internal network or add a collection/loss factor. One source waste reference is -1 m3 and the native service reference is +1 m3, so preserve the magnitude with factor -1, including negative and positive caller exchanges, formulas and uncertainty. Keep complete native operation, chemicals, sludge treatment, energy supplies, transport and emissions once, together with separately listed caller collection, transport and emissions. Actual historical source/native backgrounds, energy supplies, reagent bases, paper/plastic/sludge residue routes and ash extraction/recovery, allocations, water/biosphere definitions and vintage differ. These remain explicit screening limitations with unquantified score effects; do not reconstruct those internal differences or add a credit. The native reference and matching class/COD do not establish full composition or LCIA equivalence. Only the exact inspected 3.6 cut-off profile is admitted.
